test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the capitalized word in the given sentence.

The favoritism of the boss led to many DISGRUNTLED employees.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Pleased"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** We will learn the meaning of the words:

__
 
• **Disgruntled -** angry or dissatisfied 

 
 
• ***Eg.*** judges receive letters from *disgruntled* members of the public.
 
 
 
• **​Pleased -** willing or glad to do something 
 
 
• ​***Eg.*** we will be* pleased* to provide an independent appraisal.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see the other words with some examples:​

 
• **Disturbed -** having had the normal pattern or functioning disrupted 

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** I have a *disturbed* sleep since days.
 
 
 
• **​Determined -** having made a firm decision and being resolved not to change it 
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Alina was *determined* to be heard
 
 
 
• **​Miserable -** having made a firm decision and being of a person) wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable
 
 
• ​***Eg***. Their happiness made Anne feel even more *miserable.*
